Description
The small institution that later developed into Liverpool John Moores University was founded in 1823, and today LJMU is home to a community of 25,000 students from more than 100 countries and 2,500 staff. Offering 250 degree courses, it is one of the largest, most dynamic and forward-thinking universities in the UK. The University’s facilities deliver the highest quality student experience. They are designed to replicate industry environments, so students gain experience relevant to their career even before they graduate.
